description.en: The cast aluminium tooling-plate build plate of a 350-size Voron 2.4-class printer: 355 × 355 mm, 8 to 10 mm thick by maker. It stands on M4 thumb-nut spacers over the two bed extrusions, screwed through into M3 T-nuts in their top slots. A commercial class: the plate's size is what the cited listings share; its thickness and alloy (ATP5, MIC6, 5083) vary by maker, and no listing publishes the hole pattern.
description.es: La cama de placa de herramienta de aluminio fundido de una impresora de clase Voron 2.4 de tamaño 350: 355 × 355 mm y de 8 a 10 mm de espesor según el fabricante. Se apoya en separadores de tuercas moleteadas M4 sobre los dos perfiles de la cama, atornillada hasta tuercas en T M3 en sus ranuras superiores. Una clase comercial: el tamaño de la placa es lo que comparten los listados citados; su espesor y aleación (ATP5, MIC6, 5083) varían según el fabricante, y ningún listado publica el patrón de barrenos.
description.fr: Le plateau en plaque d'outillage en aluminium coulé d'une imprimante de classe Voron 2.4 de taille 350 : 355 × 355 mm, de 8 à 10 mm d'épaisseur selon le fabricant. Il repose sur des entretoises en écrous moletés M4 au-dessus des deux profilés du plateau, vissé jusque dans des écrous en T M3 de leurs rainures supérieures. Une classe commerciale : la taille de la plaque est ce que partagent les fiches citées ; son épaisseur et son alliage (ATP5, MIC6, 5083) varient selon le fabricant, et aucune fiche ne publie le motif de perçage.
description.pt: A mesa em placa de ferramenta de alumínio fundido de uma impressora de classe Voron 2.4 de tamanho 350: 355 × 355 mm, de 8 a 10 mm de espessura conforme o fabricante. Assenta em espaçadores de porcas serrilhadas M4 sobre os dois perfis da mesa, aparafusada até porcas em T M3 nas suas ranhuras superiores. Uma classe comercial: o tamanho da placa é o que as listagens citadas partilham; a espessura e a liga (ATP5, MIC6, 5083) variam conforme o fabricante, e nenhuma listagem publica o padrão de furos.

sources.supports: MIC6 / ATP5 cast aluminum tool plate, 3/8 in thick, milled flat, cut, drilled and tapped to the Voron 2.4 BOM; sizes 250 / 300 / 350

sources.title: Voron 2.4r2 build guide, version 2023-07-04 (VoronDesign/Voron-2 @ a192410, Manual/Assembly_Manual_2.4r2.pdf, GPL-3.0); cited by page and section only, nothing copied
sources.supports: p. 20 (Frame): the two bed extrusions are 130 mm apart, centred on the printer's centreline; p. 53 (Print bed): bolt heads sit flush or below the plate's top in bored holes; pp. 58–59 (Heated bed): M3x16 SHCS through the plate and M4 thumb nuts used as spacers into M3 T-nuts in the bed extrusions; p. 60: the plate's front edge sits 38 mm behind the frame's front edge

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the plate's underside. +z up through the plate to the build surface at z = thickness_mm; +x across the printer (left to right), +y from the front edge to the back edge; the plate spans x, y = ±177.5. The four mount interfaces are framed standoff_mm under the underside, on the two rail lines x = ±65, their x_axis along +y.

length.note: front to back; the three plate listings agree (sources 0, 1, 2)

thickness_honeybadger.note: 3/8 in; West3D's MIC6 / 5083 plates are also 3/8 in (source 3)

flatness_ldo.note: LDO's stated flatness (< 0.15 mm), the only flatness a listing gives

spacer_height.note: DIN 466 M4 thumb nut height, the guide's spacer (p. 58); the default of standoff_mm

rail_spacing.note: the bed extrusions' spacing, centred on the centreline (p. 20)

front_edge_setback.note: the plate's front edge behind the frame's front edge (p. 60)

parameters.note: By maker: 8 (Spool3D, source 0), 9.525 = 3/8 in (HoneyBadger and West3D, sources 2 and 3: the default), 10 (LDO, source 1). The range is the listings'.

Plate underside to the bed extrusion's top face. The default is a DIN 466 M4 thumb nut's height (source 4), the guide's spacer (p. 58; the guide allows other heat-resistant spacers of the same length). The range is a catalog convention.

interfaces.note: Male: an M3 screw through the plate and its spacer into an M3 T-nut in a bed extrusion's top slot. Framed on the spacer's bottom face (standoff_mm under the plate), on the rail line x = -65 (the rails 130 apart, p. 20, with the plate centred on them: a convention). The hole's position along the rail is not cited by any listing, so the interface travels along +y over its half of the plate and the assembly's mate offset sets it.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P6-ZBED lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The alloy varies by maker (ATP5, MIC6 / ATP5, 5083; sources 2, 3) and is not stated as a fact here. No listing publishes the hole pattern, so the mount interfaces travel along their rail; the guide's 38 mm front-edge setback (p. 60) and the rails' 130 mm spacing (p. 20) place the plate in the frame. Heater, magnet and thermal fuse are out of scope (D1).
